title: Coherent evaluation compared with the ordered-cone straightening adjunction
statement:
Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, coherent functor categories and transformations of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], the coherent nerve and space category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces], and the explicit rigidification $\mathfrak C$, projective simplicial model category $\mathsf D_S$, its cofibrant-fibrant subcategory $\mathsf D_S^{cf}$, right-fibration simplicial category $\mathsf{RFib}(S)$ and ordered-cone adjunction $T\dashv U_S$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-right-fibration-presentation]. Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ and a $\mathcal V$-small quasicategory $S$; all categories of small objects are formed in a containing universe. Thus $\mathsf D_S$ consists of enriched functors $\mathfrak C[S]^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}_{\mathcal V}$. Its projective weak equivalences and fibrations are objectwise, and a superscript $cf$ means projectively cofibrant and projectively fibrant.

Enriched evaluation $(s,P)\mapsto P(s)$, composed with the rigidification unit $S^{\mathrm{op}}\to N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathfrak C[S]^{\mathrm{op}})$ and transposed in the $S^{\mathrm{op}}$ variable, defines a comparison
$$\mathsf{ev}_S:N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathsf D_S^{cf})\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(S^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}).$$
This particular comparison is an equivalence. There is an equivalence
$$\Phi_S:N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathsf{RFib}(S))\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(S^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$$
and a coherent natural equivalence $\Phi_S N_{\mathrm{hc}}(U_S)\simeq\mathsf{ev}_S$ compatible with the unit and counit of the specified cone adjunction. More explicitly, for every right fibration $q:Y\to S$, every projective trivial cofibration $T_q\to P_q$ with fibrant target gives a cofibrant-fibrant $P_q$ and compatible equivalences
$$\Phi_S(q)\simeq\mathsf{ev}_S(P_q)\simeq m_q,$$
where $m_q:S^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ is the coherent fibre-transport functor defined in [lem-coef-right-fibration-section-limit]. These are equivalences of whole coherent functors. Under the comparison, evaluation at $s$ agrees with the canonical fibre comparison $Y_s\simeq P_q(s)$ induced by the cone adjunction. For maps of right fibrations, evaluation of the resulting transformation at $s$ agrees with the map of their Kan fibres, including simplicial parameters. The comparisons are natural for maps of right fibrations and base pullback; on projective diagrams, base restriction is followed by cofibrant-fibrant replacement when needed.

There is also the following compatibility with the specific coherent Hom bifunctor $H_C$ of [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality]. For every $\mathcal V$-small quasicategory $C$, vertex $c\in C$, and coherent functor $v:S\to C$, put $q_{v,c}:S\times_C C_{/c}\to S$, where $(C_{/c})_n$ is the set of maps $\Delta^{n+1}\to C$ with last vertex $c$ and the projection restricts to the initial face. There is a coherent natural equivalence
$$\Phi_S(q_{v,c})\simeq H_C(v(-),c)$$
in $\operatorname{Fun}(S^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$. At a vertex this equivalence uses the canonical right-pinched mapping-space comparison with the rigidification Hom pairing; it preserves the underlying edge $v(s)\to c$. It compares the actions and every higher simplex of these two specified functors, rather than only their values or homotopy classes of edge actions. This equivalence is coherent in $v,c$ and functors of $C$, and compatible with the preceding fibre-evaluation comparison. Empty bases and empty fibres are allowed.

These sources do not state this combined compatibility verbatim. Online HTT read; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this comparison.
